articles.summary: Kratos announced that construction of its Indiana Payload Integration Facility (IPIF) for Hypersonic Systems located in Crane, Indiana, has been completed ahead of schedule.
articles.title: Kratos Completes Construction of $50 Million State-of-the-Art Hypersonic Systems Payload Integration Facility in Indiana Ahead of Schedule

articles.summary: Kratos has recently received an approximate $36 million sole-source contract award for a new air defense missile system.
articles.title: Kratos Receives Approximate $36 Million Air Defense System Single Award Contract

articles.summary: Kratos announced the opening of a 167,000-square-foot advanced manufacturing facility in York, Pennsylvania.
articles.title: Kratos Opens New 167,000-Square-Foot Manufacturing Facility in Pennsylvania, Expanding Existing Footprint in the State

articles.summary: Kratos received an approximate $100 million sole source prime contract award for the production of a ground-based modular space domain awareness system.
articles.title: Kratos Receives Approximate $100 Million Sole Source Prime Space Domain Awareness System Program Award

articles.summary: Kratos announced a major expansion of its Oklahoma City manufacturing campus with the addition of over 100,000 square feet of manufacturing and production space.
articles.title: Kratos Expands Oklahoma City Manufacturing Facility to Accelerate Production of Valkyrie, Firejet and Other Jet Drone Systems

articles.summary: Kratos will manufacture Elroy Air's Chaparral autonomous cargo aircraft in its expanding Sacramento, California production facility
articles.title: Kratos to Manufacture Elroy Air Chaparral Autonomous Cargo Aircraft in Expanded California Facility

articles.summary: Kratos will publish financial results for the second quarter 2026 after the close of market on Tuesday, August 4th.
articles.title: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call for Tuesday, August 4th

articles.summary: Kratos has recently received approximately $400 million in funding from the Department of War related to certain hypersonic system and other National Security related programs.
articles.title: Kratos Receives Approximately $400 Million in New Funding for Hypersonic System and Other Programs

articles.summary: Kratos has been awarded a sole-source, single award IDIQ contract for approximately $156 million, by the U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) Office of Secure Transportation (OST), in support of Project Solar Shield.
articles.title: Kratos Receives Mobile Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) Approximate $156 Million Single Award Contract by U.S. Department of Energy Office of Secure Transportation

articles.summary: Kratos has successfully developed, tested, and delivered advanced turbomachinery supporting development of Lockheed Martin’s advanced ramjet propulsion system.
articles.title: Kratos Delivers Critical Component for Lockheed Martin’s High-Performance Propulsion Initiative
